verdict.rationale: Kong is an API gateway that sits in the request path, so scripting request and response handling is a fair question for it. The evidence shows plugins for request/response transformations and says the gateway can be extended through modules and plugins. That loosely covers massaging data before and after a request, but the evidence never describes user-authored scripts or chaining requests together. Missing for 10: documented pre-request/post-response scripting hooks, request chaining, scripting language/runtime details, examples of data manipulation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
